proposals.title: Yak wing-root panel seam
proposals.change: Add one thin recessed seam following the visible wing-root service panel behind the wall plane.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a shallow decal or inset strip at x>=bx+3 with low-contrast warm-gray variation; keep the in-FOV aircraft shell unchanged.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is thin, behind_wall, and does not alter the bright unlit HF shell or silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: YakBeauty retains Usable status and the seam reads as a single panel break without a dark material patch.

proposals.title: Canopy bow catchlight proxy
proposals.change: Add a narrow additive-emissive highlight along the upper canopy bow to clarify the frame edge.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small spline or thin strip with restrained white-blue emissive, camera-facing only, with opacity below the canopy reflection threshold.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only a small additive line changes; no opaque glass or dark PBR material is introduced.
proposals.acceptance_test: Canopy bow is legible in both cameras without black glass, washout, or a visible full-frame glow.

proposals.title: Canopy latch micro-tabs
proposals.change: Add two small bright latch tabs on the canopy side frame behind the wall plane.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny rounded boxes or planes with pale aluminum and a muted red indicator dot; keep each tab below the existing frame width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Two localized accents remain behind_wall and preserve the existing canopy material and silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: Latch tabs are visible as distinct cockpit hardware while all 11 cameras remain Usable.

proposals.title: Cowling inspection-plate gap
proposals.change: Add one short offset gap around a small cowling inspection plate on the Yak body.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place a thin warm-gray border and a slightly lighter plate center; avoid continuous dark lines across the fuselage.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is one localized panel gap behind the wall and cannot create a broad dark FOV region.
proposals.acceptance_test: The inspection plate reads at capture distance and does not merge into a black fuselage patch.

proposals.title: Prop hub retainer washer
proposals.change: Add a bright circular retainer washer centered on the propeller hub.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a thin pale aluminum ring with a warm center cap; place it behind the wall and keep specular response disabled.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A small bright shell improves hub segmentation without dark PBR or silhouette expansion.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hub retainer is readable in Prop and PropHub, with no clipping, halo, or uniqueness loss.

proposals.title: Prop blade-root collars
proposals.change: Add two small bright collar shells where the propeller blades meet the hub.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use paired pale shells with restrained orange identification marks; keep them narrow and centered on the existing blade roots.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The collars are small, bright, and behind_wall, preserving blade visibility and camera exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Both blade-root transitions gain readable separation without changing blade count or introducing dark bands.

proposals.title: Prop hub grease-cap glint
proposals.change: Add a tiny additive-emissive glint on the hub grease cap.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single 3D-facing cross or short crescent at very low intensity; gate it to the hub center and avoid animated bloom.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The proxy is tiny, additive, and isolated to an already bright hub feature.
proposals.acceptance_test: A controlled hub glint is visible in PropHub without blooming into the nose or altering exposure.

proposals.title: Blade-root identification shells
proposals.change: Add thin bright shell inserts on the inboard face of each visible propeller blade.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use short pale strips with a muted yellow marker, restricted to the first few percent of blade length.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The shells are local, bright, and do not change the overall blade silhouette or material value.
proposals.acceptance_test: Blade roots show clear authored separation while Prop and PropNose remain Usable.

proposals.title: Cockpit coaming lip break
proposals.change: Add one short highlight break along the cockpit coaming lip behind the wall plane.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a pale gray strip only on the front-left lip segment; leave the remaining coaming unmodified.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One short behind_wall accent clarifies the tub boundary without adding a dark interior stack.
proposals.acceptance_test: The coaming edge separates from the instrument cluster and retains the existing cockpit brightness balance.

proposals.title: Instrument hood support ridge
proposals.change: Add a slim support ridge beneath the instrument hood to define its lower edge.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow warm-gray extrusion with a light top plane; keep it behind the current hood and away from gauge faces.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The ridge is a thin local edge cue and does not occlude or darken the instruments.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hood support reads in Cockpit and ADS without covering gauge centers or lowering usability.

proposals.title: Instrument needle-center pins
proposals.change: Add small bright center pins to three primary instrument needles.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use three tiny pale emissive discs with no bloom and no change to gauge backgrounds or glass.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only three tiny additive markers are introduced, preserving all existing dark-to-light instrument contrast.
proposals.acceptance_test: Needle pivots become legible at capture scale without producing glowing dots across the panel.

proposals.title: Gauge anti-glare rim accents
proposals.change: Add two short pale rim arcs to the largest visible instrument bezels.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use partial arcs rather than full rings; keep them thin, matte, and offset behind the existing gauge faces.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Partial bright arcs add bezel structure without introducing full-ring occlusion or reflective black glass.
proposals.acceptance_test: The two largest gauges gain readable bezel edges while their needles and numerals remain unobstructed.

proposals.title: Cockpit tub floor rib
proposals.change: Add one narrow raised floor rib running from the seat base toward the pedal area.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-profile light-gray rib with a short terminating end; keep it behind the wall and outside the main instrument silhouette.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single shallow floor cue improves tub construction without adding a large geometry stack.
proposals.acceptance_test: The floor rib separates cockpit depth and does not cross the pilot hand, pedals, or instrument faces.

proposals.title: Pedal hinge caps
proposals.change: Add two small bright hinge caps at the visible rudder pedal pivots.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use very low-intensity circular proxies at the pivot points, with a warm aluminum tint and no bloom.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The two proxies are tiny additive details located in the lower cockpit and cannot affect exterior cameras.
proposals.acceptance_test: Pedal pivot locations read as mechanical hardware without visible emissive spill.

proposals.title: Glove cuff seam
proposals.change: Add one thin light seam around the pilot glove cuff.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place a narrow pale seam at the wrist transition, using low contrast and no dark outline.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is localized to the glove and uses a bright unlit value instead of dark PBR.
proposals.acceptance_test: The hand-to-sleeve transition is readable in both views without changing hand pose or occluding controls.

proposals.title: Glove knuckle panel breaks
proposals.change: Add two small pale panel breaks across the glove knuckles.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use short segmented strips following the knuckle direction; avoid a continuous bright band around the hand.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Segmented micro-accents remain behind_wall and add hand construction without changing silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: Knuckle articulation is visible at capture distance without making the glove glossy or overbright.

proposals.title: Glove-arm elbow fold
proposals.change: Add one short raised fold on the exposed glove-arm sleeve near the elbow.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a shallow curved strip with a warm cloth-gray material; place it on the already visible sleeve plane only.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The fold is one small cloth cue behind the wall and does not introduce a hero limb stack.
proposals.acceptance_test: Sleeve depth reads as fabric construction without a hard metallic edge or added occlusion over the controls.

proposals.title: Gunner harness buckle face
proposals.change: Add one bright rectangular face to the visible gunner-station harness buckle.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small pale shell on the buckle front with a muted red center slot; keep the strap itself unchanged.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The buckle face is a single small behind_wall hardware accent and cannot affect exterior framing.
proposals.acceptance_test: The harness termination is identifiable without turning the strap into a dark high-contrast shape.

proposals.title: Canopy side-rail catchlight
proposals.change: Add a short additive-emissive catchlight on the visible canopy side rail.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one restrained pale-blue segment on the rail midpoint, camera-facing and clipped to the existing frame thickness.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is small and additive, with no opaque black-glass or full-rail replacement.
proposals.acceptance_test: The side rail separates from the canopy in both views without bloom, washout, or silhouette growth.

proposals.title: Yak access-panel paint edge
proposals.change: Add a thin pale painted edge on one small fuselage access panel behind the wall plane.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a broken, non-continuous edge with two small interruptions so it reads as painted hardware rather than a stripe.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The edge is a tiny bright behind_wall accent and avoids broad graphic lines or dark material replacement.
proposals.acceptance_test: The access panel gains a readable authored boundary without changing YakBeauty composition or uniqueness.
